edit.description: The one home for a member's id-from-unit-shape, beside `path_shaped_id` (already shared for exactly this reason): a derivation over `kind.unit_shape` returning the id or a format-neutral fault naming the absent component (path directory / file stem / named field), plus `fold_file_id` moved here from `frontmatter.rs` as `pub(crate)` over that same fault. Unit tests per arm.

`Member::from_source_rooted`'s four-arm `UnitShape` match (184-206) becomes one call into the shared home, mapping the fault to `FrontmatterError::NoId`/`NoNamedFieldId` with its messages unchanged; `fold_file_id` (375) leaves, its doc cite at 163 follows.

`DocumentMember::parse`'s four-arm match (226-252) becomes the same call, mapping the fault to `NoPathIdentity`/`NoStemIdentity`/`NoIdentityValue`; the file arm passes the source's own parent as the fold base, so its id is byte-unchanged (the real base is the chained entry's).

`parse` keeps its own `NoDeclaredIdentity` refusal for a non-`named-field` shape (48-59 — a format policy, not an id derivation) and takes the id itself off the shared home, mapping the fault to `NoIdentityValue`.
The `fold_file_id` call at 652 follows the move to its new home; nothing else in `layout_unit` changes.
The `crate::frontmatter::fold_file_id` intra-doc link at 1090 follows the move — the crate denies `rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links`.
No change expected (every id and every error message is preserved); inside the fence so an assertion refresh the fold surfaces can land with the change.

summary: A member's id-from-unit-shape is derived in three faces (frontmatter, json-document, toml-document) — fold them onto one home each face maps into its own error vocabulary.

tests.asserts: the shared derivation answers each `UnitShape` arm — folded file stem, named-field value, path-shaped directory name — and names the absent component per fault; every arm asserted, not the happy one alone
`a_path_shaped_json_document_reads_the_id_its_frontmatter_peer_reads` and `a_file_shaped_json_document_names_itself_by_its_stem` stay green — every face's id is byte-unchanged through the shared home
`FrontmatterError::NoNamedFieldId` still surfaces for a named-field source carrying no value — a mapped fault keeps each face's own vocabulary

acceptance: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and the afterMerge doc gate green, with no id derivation over `kind.unit_shape` left outside `src/extract.rs`.
notes: Verified on disk: frontmatter.rs:184-206, json_manifest.rs:226-252, toml_document.rs:48-59 each match `UnitShape` for identity, and the copies have drifted — the frontmatter file arm folds placement (`fold_file_id`), the document faces take a bare `file_stem`. Behavior-preserving here: the document faces pass the source's own parent, which is what `Member::from_source` already defaults to. scoped at 9024e2c8
